{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Black faux-shearling-lined wool coat, tailored single-breasted, knee length, deep emerald green (#046307), heavy brushed wool
Fitted turtleneck sweater, slim cut, hip length, cream (#F2E8D5), merino wool
Dark straight-leg jeans, high rise, full length, ink indigo (#1F2A44), stretch denim
Warm opaque tights under the jeans are not needed; thermal socks, ankle height, charcoal (#36454F), merino blend
Lug-sole ankle boots, waterproof, rounded toe, glossy black (#111111), treated leather with a grippy rubber sole
Oversized scarf, long, rust orange (#B7410E), soft lambswool
Knit beanie, slouchy, cuffed, mustard (#E1AD01), chunky wool
Leather gloves, wrist length, cognac (#9A4E1C), wool-lined leather

Why this outfit works: The emerald coat is the bold statement piece, and the rust scarf and mustard beanie add a confident, saturated colour play that makes you stand out against a snowy city. Everything is warm enough for a day at minus three and lasts until evening, with a merino layer under the coat that you can take off comfortably in cafés. Waterproof lug-sole boots handle snow and road salt while keeping the look polished, and dark denim keeps the everyday feel relaxed so the colours do the talking."}
